text:
maya: Quick heads-up — onboarding magnet-70k-int3 today. Short smoke found divergence only when we prefill a very long anchored system prompt and then resume streaming. Repro below.

liam: Drop the tiny repro so I can run locally.

maya: Minimal repro (py):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(model="magnet-70k-int3")
anchor = 'SYSTEM_ANCHOR ' * 1400  # ~35k tokens
out = c.generate(prefix=anchor + '\nUser: Describe plate tectonics in detail')
print(out.tokens[-6:])  # divergence around token ~31322
```
Observed: expected token 31322 'moved' but got ' the'. Happens reliably after resume. No divergence with empty anchor.

sarah: So int3-only? int8/fp16 clean?

maya: Correct. int8 and fp16 runs match baseline. int3 shows mismatch.

liam: My quick suspicion: index arithmetic overflow when combining global_offset + pos for KV slot calculation, maybe half-word (15-bit) truncation in quant pack routine. Can you dump the KV index window around the glitch?

maya: KV slice produced from runtime dump: (idx -> key_hash)
```
[32766] -> 0x5b7e...
[32767] -> 0x2c1a...
[16383] -> 0x5b7e...  # collided back earlier in buffer
[16384] -> 0x9d11...
```
Collision shows half-window aliasing (wrap at 16384) instead of full window.

eden: That pattern screams "half-range mask" — e.g., using 14/15-bit intermediate types somewhere. Which pack routine is used on int3 build? pack_v3?

liam: pack_v3 for int3. There was a fast-path change in pack_v3 to use uint16 temp for index math to speed kernels. I pushed a micro-opt last week (pack16-rolloff).

zach: Can you repro with RW_INDEX_SAFE_MODE=1 to force 32-bit index arithmetic? If that mitigates, we know it's packing-related.

maya: Kicked off local with RW_INDEX_SAFE_MODE=1. Also fired CI reproducer job: https://ci.internal/jobs/9843 (will attach logs).

ci-bot: CI job 9843 started — artifact: https://ci.internal/jobs/9843/artifacts

liam: If safe-mode fixes it, quick patch would be to revert the pack16-rolloff change or add a corrective mask (full_window_mask) in index combine path. But I'd prefer a bisect to be sure.

sarah: Who can bisect the two recent commits touching packing/math? Candidates: pack16-rolloff (opt), rotor-normalize-v3 (rotary refactor).

eden: I can run bisect tomorrow. Checklist I'm tracking: 1) repro with RW_INDEX_SAFE_MODE=1, 2) repro with --no-kv-cache to see if streaming-only affects, 3) dump raw rotary angles for positions 31290..31340, 4) run int8/fp32 for comparison.

maya: Telemetry dump command I used:
```bash
./bin/kv_inspect --model magnet-70k-int3 --slice 31280:31340 > kv_slice.txt
sed -n '1,200p' kv_slice.txt | grep -n "alias\|collision" || true
```
kv_slice.txt flagged the half-window alias entries.

liam: Also check runtime/rotary/phase.c around the pos->angle compute. There was a branch that casts offset to uint16 for the small-seq fastpath — that could be the culprit.

sarah: Owner assignments: eden -> bisect + reproduce variants, liam -> audit pack_v3 and rotary fastpaths, maya -> attach reproducer and telemetry to ticket, zach -> prepare canary plan for Dedicated if we have a quick fix.

maya: Filed ticket ML-1432 with reproducer + artifacts: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-1432. Workaround noted: set RW_INDEX_SAFE_MODE=1 or use int8 build.

liam: If RW_INDEX_SAFE_MODE is effective, let's stage a canary rollback of pack16-rolloff in a controlled cluster and run the long-prefill smoke across sample corpora.

ci-bot: CI job 9843 finished — status: reproduced (divergence). Logs/artifacts uploaded.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Eden, ping when you have the bisect result and PR candidate. We'll sync in the morning. :white_check_mark:
